en.bdb: The heart of the Sikh of the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਹੋਦੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਜੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis viTahu vaariaa hodhai taan ju hoi nitaanaa|

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who being mighty considers himself powerless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਹੋਦੈ ਮਾਣਿ ਜੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis viTahu vaariaa hodhai maan ju rahai nimaanaa|

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who being grand considers himself humble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis viTahu vaariaa chhodd siaanap hoi iaanaa|

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who repudiating all cleverness becomes childlike

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis viTahu vaariaa khasamai dhaa bhaavai jis bhaanaa|

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who loves the will of the Master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis viTahu vaariaa gurmuikh maarag dhekh lubhaanaa|

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who becoming gurmukh wishes to follow the way of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis viTahu vaariaa chalan jaan jugat mihamaanaa|

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who considers himself a guest in this world and keeps himself ready to depart from here.
Such a person is acceptable here and in the hereafter.
